$comment: DD-02 — dated risk acceptances for `npm audit`, consumed by scripts/check-audit-allowlist.mjs.
An entry here is a deliberate, time-boxed decision, not a mute: once `expires` passes,
the build fails on it exactly as if it were unlisted. Shrink this list; never extend a
date without re-assessing. Every entry below is a devDependency — none ships to the edge
runtime (`npm audit --omit=dev` reports only hono, which PR #839 resolves).
Remediation for all of these is already open as Dependabot PRs; the blocker is review
throughput (DD-01), which the dependabot-auto-merge workflow addresses.

allow.name: wrangler
allow.reason: devDependency only (CLI). Transitively vulnerable via miniflare -> sharp -> libheif. Not reachable from the deployed Worker. Fix open as PR #861 / #853.

allow.name: miniflare
allow.reason: devDependency only (local Workers emulator). Vulnerable via sharp -> libheif. Fix open as PR #861.

allow.name: sharp
allow.reason: devDependency only, pulled in by miniflare. libheif CVEs require decoding attacker-supplied HEIF; no such path in dev tooling. Fix open as PR #861.

allow.name: @redocly/openapi-core
allow.reason: devDependency of openapi-typescript (contract generation). Vulnerable via js-yaml. Fix open as PR #862.

allow.name: js-yaml
allow.reason: devDependency, transitively via @redocly/openapi-core. The package.json override now pins ^4.3.2, which is outside the advisory range; entry retained until the lockfile resolves. Fix open as PR #862.

allow.name: nanoid
allow.reason: devDependency (build tooling). Infinite loop requires a custom generator with size 0, which is not used.

allow.name: @xmldom/xmldom
allow.reason: devDependency only. Fix open as PR #849.

allow.name: browserslist
allow.reason: devDependency (build-time target resolution). Fix open as PR #857.

allow.name: fast-uri
allow.reason: devDependency, transitive. Fix open as PR #850.
